verdicts.reason: A keeps a clear left-to-right flow: the headline is dominant, the date, time, tags and RSVP button are grouped in the middle, and the phone sits on the right. Flaws: the partner-logo placeholder overlaps the phone edge, the legal text is tiny, the headline crowds the left edge and circle, and the right edge is tight. B has a huge grey placeholder box dominating the right side, with illegible legal text above it. B also stacks 'Live music and rooftop pours' in a narrow four-line column, and the 'RSVP Free' CTA is shrunk into a tag pill with the tags and loses its prominence. The headline is also cramped against the circle.
